name: Wiro Agent Connectors
description: MCP connectors for 45 services with no official MCP server, such as Gmail, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Shopify, YouTube and Notion; each one runs as its own stdio server with your own API key or OAuth token. Install: `npx -y @wiro-ai/wiro-agent-connectors <connector>` (`--list` prints them all) · [Docs](https://github.com/wiroai/Wiro-Agent-Connectors#readme)
